visualCharacteristics: Embedded third-party page in an iframe, framed (1px border, rounded) by default, loaded when near the viewport.
contentPattern: Single row with the embed URL link.
usage: Embedded maps, dashboards and third-party widgets. A height-<px> class (e.g. height-1100) sets the frame height.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any iframe embed; add height-<px> to match the source frame height.
